'''Ostrowski''' ({{IPA|pl|ɔsˈtrɔfskʲi}}; feminine: '''Ostrowska''') is a [[Polish surname]]. It is a [[toponymic surname]] derived from any of places named [[Ostrów (disambiguation)|Ostrów]], [[Ostrowo (disambiguation)|Ostrowo]], [[Ostrowsko (disambiguation)|Ostrowsko]]<ref>[https://nazwiska.ijppan.pl/haslo/show/name/OSTROWSKI OSTROWSKI]</ref><ref>{{cite book|url= https://www.google.com/books/edition/Dictionary_of_American_Family_Names/FJoDDAAAQBAJ?hl=en&gbpv=1&dq=Origin+of+the+name+Ostrowski&pg=RA2-PA27&printsec=frontcover |page=27 |title=Dictionary of American Family Names Volume 3 |editor-first=Patrick |editor-last=Hanks |publisher=Oxford University Press |date=2003 |isbn=9780199771691 |via=Google Books |access-date=1 November 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|last=Glicenstein |first=Ze'ev |title=Roots and remembrance: explorations in Jewish genealogy |page=103 |location=Toronto |publisher=Ontario Genealogical Society |date=2006 |isbn=9780777921609 |quote=Surnames drawn from toponyms or place names ... Ostrowski,...}}</ref> It is related to several surnames in other languages.
